display_long_description:
NavigatorPro XR brings case review and planning into an immersive environment on Meta Quest 3. Visualize patient-specific 3D anatomy at true scale and inspect the interior with an interactive cutting plane that moves along the perpendicular axis and rotates around its own axis—without changing the model’s scale. Interaction is fast and natural thanks to micro-gestures (tap and swipes) that let you navigate, orient, and analyze smoothly.

Collaboration is native: create shared rooms where the whole team sees the same state of the case in real time, even when someone joins later. Integrated voice chat streamlines discussion and decision-making. You can also toggle the visibility of structures and devices to focus attention on what matters, with all changes synchronized for every participant.

Designed for clinical teams, biomedical engineers, and health education, NavigatorPro XR helps you:

Understand patient anatomy in 3D at true scale.

Evaluate trajectories and position devices on the model.

Coordinate multidisciplinary discussions clearly and efficiently.

Compatibility: Meta Quest 3.
Notice: NavigatorPro XR is a professional viewer intended for visual support and training; it is not designed for diagnosis and does not replace clinical judgment.
